title: Internal: waiving an Auto Loans returned payment fee caused by a debit to a closed account
content:
# Internal: waiving an Auto Loans returned payment fee caused by a debit to a closed account

This entry of the Auto Loans product category at PCB applies to a returned payment fee charged on an auto loan after an autopay debit that PCB presented to a PCB checking account its own records show was already closed. Such a fee is assessed contrary to the Auto Loans charter and is waived in full for bank error, as one fee waiver entry that names the fee. The waiver is triggered by the state of the loan's records, not by a request from the borrower.

Observable effect for the borrower: the waiver and the reduced balances appear on the loan.

## Tool: waive_returned_payment_fee_ab31cb83

**Situation of use and capability.** Waives in full, as a PCB bank-error correction, one returned payment fee charged on a borrower's auto loan. One call books a fee waiver entry on the loan's activity for the named returned payment fee, with the waiver reason recorded as bank error and the fee code recorded as returned payment. On the loan it lowers the unpaid fees by the waived amount less the part stated as applied to principal, and lowers the unpaid principal by that applied part (used only when the fee had already been paid).

**How it is invoked.** An internal tool of the agent: it must first be unlocked with unlock_agent_discoverable_tool and then called with call_agent_discoverable_tool.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| customer_id | the customer reference number of the borrower, from the customer profile lookup | reference number |
| auto_loan_id | the auto loan reference number of the loan the fee was charged on, from the auto loan lookup | reference number |
| source_item_id | the reference number of the returned payment fee entry being waived, as listed in the auto loan activity lookup | reference number |
| amount | the amount waived, equal to the whole fee | USD, 2 decimal places |
| applied_to_principal | the part of the waived amount credited to principal because the fee had already been paid | USD, 2 decimal places; 0.00 when the fee was still unpaid |

**Return.** On success the receipt shows status "waived" with: waiver_id (reference number of the new waiver entry), waived_fee_id (the fee entry waived), amount (USD, 2 decimal places), fees_due and principal_balance afterwards (USD, 2 decimal places).

## Basis Q&A

**Does the borrower need to ask for this waiver?** No. It follows from the loan's records.

**What shows that the call worked?** A receipt with status "waived" and the new waiver entry's reference number.
